tips_en: Start with Paper 2 (Random Attention) for its surprising finding that uniformly random KV-cache eviction matches sophisticated scoring methods, making it the most thought-provoking read. Then move to Paper 1 (PAW/Compile-by-Training) which offers a complementary practical angle on deployment efficiency through LoRA-based neural compilation. All three papers share a theme of LLM efficiency and autonomy—Paper 2 attacks inference cost, Paper 1 reduces deployment latency, and Paper 3 explores whether models can self-improve without human-specified objectives.
tips_zh: 建议先读第二篇（Random Attention），其发现随机均匀的KV缓存淘汰策略与复杂评分方法效果相当，反直觉的结论最引人深思。然后阅读第一篇（PAW/Compile-by-Training），它通过基于LoRA的神经编译提供了互补的部署效率实践视角。三篇论文共同聚焦于大模型的效率与自主性主题——第二篇攻克推理成本，第一篇降低部署延迟，第三篇探讨模型能否在无人工指定目标的情况下自主改进。
